title: Trial containers start nested sandboxes on an AppArmor host
description: With the Docker CLI and apparmor_parser stubbed: on a host reporting AppArmor enabled, install plans and loads the graphyard-trial profile (flags=(unconfined) with userns) and the trial container is created with --security-opt=apparmor=graphyard-trial, never apparmor=unconfined; without AppArmor neither happens. Doctor prints a FAIL trial-apparmor line naming AppArmor and the fix when the profile is not loaded or the nested sandbox is denied. A trial whose nested sandbox is denied is a trial-host fault: no verdict on the head, no base failure, reported upstream once.

steps.name: AppArmor trial profile, doctor line and nested-sandbox trial-host fault
